executeMint(bytes32,uint256).details: LIQ-MGMT (audit H5 + M2): the caller passes a `minMinted` floor      (1e18 scale MTQ). The mint reverts with Err93_SlippageExceeded if      the actual minted amount (after price + throttle) falls below it.      The mint also reverts with Err94_PerTxCapExceeded if the requested      USD amount exceeds MAX_MINT_PER_TX ($500K). Pass minMinted = 0 to      disable slippage protection (e.g. for keeper-relayed bank requests      where the bank has signed off on the exact expected output).

useStabilityPoolForDeficit(uint256).details: The deficit is in 1e18 scale USD; the pool is in 6-dec USDC.      We scale the deficit down to 6-dec to compare against the pool.

DOMAIN_SEPARATOR().notice: EIP-2612 domain separator. EIP-712 domain: name = the ERC-20         token name returned by name() ("MTQ Sigma V3"), version "1",         chainId = live chain id, verifyingContract = this contract.         Cached per chain (see _cachedDomainSeparator).

MONETARY_CONTROL_ROLE().notice: V3 new role: MITHQAL Monetary Control — the L4 authorization         signer for executeMint (separate from KEEPER so the keeper         cannot self-authorize a mint).

accumulatedFees().notice: Total fees accrued (1e18 scale USD) since deployment.

accumulatedRewardPerShare().notice: Accumulated reward per share (1e18 scale, USDC-denominated).         pending(depositor) = deposit * accumulatedRewardPerShare / 1e18         minus the depositor's `rewardDebt` snapshot.

advanceWorkflow(bytes32,uint8).notice: Advance a request through the workflow. Only KEEPER (BM-02..BM-14)         or MONETARY_CONTROL (BM-15) may advance. State transitions must         be strictly sequential (no skipping). The keeper performs the         L3 policy checks (KYC/AML/eligibility/jurisdiction/bank-risk/         system-risk/DMCE) off-chain and only calls advanceWorkflow when         the corresponding gate has passed. The L4 monetary authorization         gate (BM-15) requires the MONETARY_CONTROL_ROLE signer.

backingVerified(address).notice: V3 NEW: per-bank verified backing (in USD, 1e18 scale).         This is the SUM of all verified ABC amounts for that bank.         The contract DOES NOT custody the underlying — it only tracks         the verified evidence amount.

bankMintedTotal(address).notice: Per-bank concentration: total outstanding MTQ minted via this bank.

clock().notice: IERC-6372: the voting timepoint source = block number         (ERC-20 Votes standard; snapshot-style governance reads).

delegate(address).notice: EIP-5805: delegate msg.sender's entire current voting weight         to `delegatee`. Emits DelegateChanged + DelegateVotesChanged.         Delegation moves only voting power, never balances.

delegateBySig(address,uint256,uint256,ui.notice: EIP-5805: signature-based delegation. Reverts with         Err106_DelegationExpired (expiry passed), Err104_InvalidSignature         (unrecoverable signer) and Err107_InvalidDelegationNonce (nonce         mismatch). Shares the nonces counter with permit().

delegates(address).notice: EIP-5805 delegation record: account => current delegatee.         address(0) = undelegated. Undelegated accounts hold ZERO         votes (OZ semantics): holding a balance is not voting power;         delegation is opt-in (the canonical pattern is self-delegation).

depositToStabilityPool(uint256).notice: Deposit USDC into the stability pool. The depositor MUST have         approved the contract to spend `usdcAmount` of `stabilityAsset`.         Any pending rewards are settled into the deposit balance first         (auto-compounding). Reverts if the asset is not set.

dmceBankConcentrationCap().notice: DMCE: Daily Mint Cap & Concentration Exposure — single-bank cap         as a fraction of total supply (1e18 scale). Default 5%.

executeMint(bytes32,uint256).notice: L5+L6+L7 FINALITY GATE — execute the mint atomically.         Requires state == BM15_AUTHORIZED (L2/L5), oracle healthy (L3         recheck), keeper signature (L7). Single transaction = atomic         write (L6). Mints MTQ to the bank; the bank distributes to the         corporate customer off-chain (sovereign currency settlement).

feeWallet().notice: Dedicated fee wallet (Constitutional Council set). Zero until set.

getPastTotalSupply(uint256).notice: EIP-5805: total supply at the end of past block `timepoint`         (all mints/burns are checkpointed in _mint/_burn).

getPastVotes(address,uint256).notice: EIP-5805: voting weight of `account` at the end of past block         `timepoint` (binary-searched checkpoint lookup). Reverts with         Err108_FutureTimepoint for the current or a future block.

getVotes(address).notice: EIP-5805: current voting weight of `account` — the latest         checkpoint (zero if `account` was never delegated to).

lastRewardUpdate().notice: Unix seconds of the last reward accrual checkpoint.

nonces(address).notice: EIP-2612 replay-protection counter per owner. Shared by         permit() and delegateBySig() (OZ Nonces semantics: the nonce         is consumed by post-increment exactly once per successful use).

pendingStabilityReward(address).notice: Read-only: compute the pending reward for a depositor.

permit(address,address,uint256,uint256,u.notice: EIP-2612 gasless approval. Reverts with Err103_PermitExpired         when block.timestamp > deadline and Err104_InvalidSignature         when the recovered signer is not the owner (or owner is 0).         nonces[owner] is consumed exactly once per successful call.

redeem(uint256,address).notice: V3 non-custodial redeem — burns MTQ from the redeemer and emits         a `RedeemSettlement` event. The bank settles with the redeemer         off-chain (sovereign currency transfer). The contract itself         does NOT push USDC: there is no reserveVault in V3.         Only an authorized bank can call this on behalf of a redeemer         (the redeemer must have approved the bank to burn their MTQ via         the standard ERC-20 allowance).

rejectMint(bytes32,string).notice: Reject a request (terminal). Keeper or Monetary Control only.

requestMint((address,bytes32,uint256,byt.notice: Request a mint — only an authorized bank. Creates state=BM01_PENDING.

setDailyRedeemCap(uint256).notice: LIQ-MGMT T7: Constitutional Council sets the daily redemption         cap (1e18 scale USD). The cap MUST be > 0; passing 0 reverts         with Err87_DailyCapZero. The change takes effect immediately         for the current 24h window (does not reset dailyRedeemedUsd).

setDmceConcentrationCap(uint256).notice: V3 NEW: Risk Council can adjust the DMCE single-bank         concentration cap. Capped at 30% (§5.6 hard ceiling).

setFeeWallet(address).notice: Constitutional Council sets the dedicated fee wallet.         address(0) is rejected — once a feeWallet is set, it can         only be replaced, never zeroed.

setStabilityAsset(address).notice: Constitutional Council sets the USDC (or 6-dec stable) asset         the stability pool accepts. address(0) disables deposits.

setStabilityRewardRate(uint256).notice: Risk Council sets the per-second reward rate (1e18 scale         fraction of totalStabilityPool). 0 = no rewards. Capped at         1e15 (0.1%/sec ≈ 100% in 10 sec — a hard ceiling to prevent         a misconfigured rate from draining the pool instantly).

stabilityAsset().notice: USDC (or any 6-dec stable) accepted by the stability pool.         Set by the Constitutional Council via `setStabilityAsset`.         address(0) = pool disabled.

stabilityRewardDebt(address).notice: Per-depositor reward debt (1e18 scale) — the         accumulatedRewardPerShare value at the depositor's last         deposit/withdraw checkpoint. Used to compute pending rewards.

stabilityRewardRate().notice: Reward rate per second, as a 1e18 fraction of totalStabilityPool.         Default 0 (no rewards until the Risk Council sets it).

totalStabilityPool().notice: Total USDC currently in the pool (6-dec).

useStabilityPoolForDeficit(uint256).notice: In EMERGENCY (currentState == EMERGENCY, i.e. RR < 1.0),         the keeper can deploy the stability pool to cover the         protocol's deficit. The pool covers up to         min(deficitUsd, totalStabilityPool). The covered amount is         NOT removed from any individual depositor's balance — it         is taken proportionally from the entire pool, and each         depositor's balance is reduced by their pro-rata share.         This is the SOLE recovery path out of EMERGENCY.

verifyBackingCertificate(bytes32).notice: Verify an ABC's custodian attestation. Production: oracle call.         Testnet/pilot: keeper auto-verifies (the keeper is trusted).

withdrawFromStabilityPool(uint256).notice: Withdraw USDC from the stability pool. Settles pending rewards         first (auto-compounding), then transfers the requested amount         back to the depositor. Reverts if the depositor has insufficient         balance (after the reward settlement).
